reason: Analyte task 2026-11-03 follow-up to #279: in the same 12 drives / 11 games, quarter and start clock came from drive_quarter_start/drive_game_clock_start of a stray neighbouring nflverse `drive` tag. When a fixed_drive's snaps carry more than one nflverse drive tag, quarter and clock now come from the drive's first snap (qtr, time). Listed games may change only quarter/clock (qtr_clock_fix_ok). Of the 12 #279 drives, 10 (in 9 games) change; 2019_08_ARI_NO and 2023_12_PIT_CIN already had the first snap's quarter and clock.
